chunk.content: In Japan, bigeye tuna (Thunnus obesus) meat is highly priced and processed into sashimi as a substitute for bluefin tuna.
chunk.source_quote: In Japan, its meat is highly priced and processed into sashimi in substitution for bluefin tuna.
